newsitem.title: UK: NYNEX CableComms to undercut BT on prices.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX CableComms to undercut BT on prices.

text.p: UK cable communications company NYNEX CableComms said on Sunday it planned to undercut British Telecommunications prices significantly with the launch of its basic rate ISDN services this month.

"NYNEX CableComms will be charging customers a 285 pound connection charge and rental of 22 pounds per month -- significantly less than equivalent BT packages," NYNEX said in a statement released in London. "NYNEX CableComms is to significantly undercut BT prices."

Britain's second largest cable communications firm, NYNEX said it would launch the service in two phases -- to selected business areas by the year-end and to all business customers by the middle of 1997. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
